name: Biped
description: Two-legged mech. Never statically stable: it stands on one foot for most of the cycle, so it needs a big Gyro Stabilizer. A stress test for the stabilizer model.

name: Hexapod
description: Insect layout with coxa + femur + tibia legs and a tripod gait. Wide, low, always three feet down.

name: Quad Crawler
description: Same frame as the Quad Strider but with a wave gait and hull sway (comShift): one leg up at a time and the hull leans toward the support triangle. Statically stable, half the speed.

name: Quad Strider
description: Mech-style quadruped. Trot gait (diagonal pairs) for speed; two feet down is never statically stable, so it carries a Gyro Stabilizer.
